review_candidates.title: Corporate Real Estate & Facility Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description FM is establishing a state-of-the-art Research Center in Luxembourg (FMST), a strategic investment that will strengthen the company’s global leadership in property loss prevention and risk management. Designed to support advanced research, testing, and innovation, the facility will bring together world-class expertise, cutting-edge technologies, and collaborative workspaces to develop solutions that help protect businesses worldwide. This landmark project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the launch and long-term success of a world-class research and innovation hub. The Corporate Real Estate & Facility Manager is responsible to oversee all property and facility related aspects of FM's Science and Technology Center, Luxembourg property operations, and overseeing day-to-day operations and maintenance of that assigned property. Ensures facilities operate efficiently, comply with company standards, and support a safe, productive work environment. Manages financial processes including budgets for operations and capital, vendor relationships, and facility upkeep including janitorial, landscaping, building systems, research and lab operations and food services. Direct oversight of external facilities team, food service team, and other providers. Assists with development of any future fit-out requirements on construction projects. Acts as primary liaison between internal stakeholders, service providers, and management to ensure operational excellence. Responsible for generating annual capital and operational budgets. Requires strong working knowledge of local building codes, workplace safety, and facilities regulations. Responsibilities Include Facilities Operations & Maintenance Oversee functionality and maintenance of critical equipment by applying corporate facilities standards, lease requirements, and engineering best practices Manage preventative maintenance and reactive repair by skilled tradesmen Coordinate repair and maintenance activities to minimize downtime and ensure continuity Conduct weekly facility inspections and maintain checklists to proactively address issues Ensure overall facility upkeep meets industry standards and supports a productive work environment Collaborate with FM engineering, risk and security teams Safety, Security & Compliance Ensure all property and facility related safety equipment is functional and maintain accurate records Resolve access badge issues and security concerns in collaboration with Security Participate and provide recommendations in EHS meetings & engineering audits Maintain accurate asset tracker and ensure compliance with Security agreements Ensure property and facility related safety programs are in place Financial Management Manage and process invoices related to Corporate Real Estate (CRE), including office rent, electricity, parking, and other associated costs Ensure timely tracking and payment of all property and facility-related expenses Collect and submit energy & budgetary data to internal stakeholders Manage property and facility related capital and operational budgets Plan and manage annual facilities operating budget Property and Facility Vendor & Service Provider Management Manage direct vendors for site-related activities (HVAC, janitorial, food services and catering staff) Manage RFP and vendor selection process Negotiate contracts Liaise with service providers to resolve property-related issues promptly, balancing cost, urgency, and business impact Develop and monitor specifications for facilities vendors Manage third-party service providers to ensure assets are maintained to Class A standards Determine specific service contract requirements, develop scope of work, solicit bids, evaluate proposals and monitor contract performance Property and Facility Staff Management Lead and coordinate internal and external Facilities staff for assigned properties Assign work orders, set priorities, and coach team members on troubleshooting and problem resolution Foster an efficient working environment essential to performance of the business Space Management & Construction Support Provide facilities oversight for assigned office locations Coordinate space planning and operational alignment Review and recommend value-add facilities related capital projects Review construction plans with FM Engineering for construction and renovation projects and maintain oversight Oversee property and facility related construction projects Represent FM on Contractors management and ensure Contractors' safety compliance Meetings & Reporting Maintain priority task tracker and conduct weekly/monthly review meetings with service providers Hold weekly in-house team meetings to review ongoing issues and ensure timely resolution Responsible for incident control, management, activation of rightful parties for incident response and timely reporting/escalation Qualifications Qualified candidates must have: Bachelor’s degree preferably in Engineering, Facility Management, Property Management degree or equivalent education in related field 10 years of prior experience in a facility/property management capacity including managing external vendors and building system expertise. Certified Facilities Manager (CFM) is preferred. Experience in commissioning a new facility a plus. Working knowledge of facilities-related laws and regulations including building codes, fire and life safety, workplace health and safety, environmental and accessibility requirements Strong technical knowledge of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, data center operations, safety systems, architectural, energy management, reporting and landscaping Ability to interpret and apply local regulatory requirements (permits, inspections, certifications) to facilities operations, maintenance, and construction projects Thorough understanding of applicable local regulatory regulations related to environmental, health and safety, risk management, and global business continuity Proven ability to assess and resolve complex facilities and operational issues by balancing risk, cost, safety and business impact Ability to work autonomously in a matrixed environment, exercising sound judgement Ability to quickly adjust priorities, adapt and change direction in fast-paced environment Ability to evaluate stakeholder needs and prioritize competing requests Working knowledge of operating and capital expense planning including budget forecasting, tracking and cost control Strong understanding of contract management and negotiation Excellent communication and presentation skills, both oral and written A history of successful facilities management leadership with demonstrated quantifiable results Exceptional customer service and relationship-building: strong follow-through and dedication to excellence in service Fluency in English and French required. German is a plus. review_candidates.title: Cloud Architect
review_candidates.description: Avanade is the perfect stage to bring your thoughtful, energetic, and curious approach to technology consulting. Our talented Azure Platform Practice consists of some of the most dedicated and passionate in the field and we plan to grow! With Avanade, you will be focusing on the Azure Public Cloud, Edge and Hybrid and working with the newest Microsoft technologies on exciting client projects. If you like pushing boundaries by outsmarting challenges, read on! Come join us The Azure Platform Practice is at the core of Avanade's excellence: delivering high-quality, complex projects with global impact. We focus on building and running reliable and secure cloud foundations - from large-scale landing zones to data and application platforms. We are committed to making our clients' cloud journey smooth - whether it's moving existing systems to help in datacenter exits, or creating new cloud-native solutions, or improving an existing cloud presence. Innovation and client satisfaction are part of our essence. Our team is a fast-growing, diverse group of more than 150 passionate enthusiasts and specialists in Azure technologies. We actively acknowledge and reward quality, encourage learning and have a strong focus on the career and development opportunities of all our people, making sure our employees are proud of working at Avanade is central to us! Together we do what matters. What You’ll Do Use your deep knowledge of Azure cloud services to design resilient, scalable and secure cloud environments covering the full breadth of the Azure platform Design and implement Azure Landing Zones to establish a scalable, secure and compliant foundation for deploying cloud services. Lead complex migrations for on-premises infrastructure, applications, and databases to Azure. Develop solutions for Edge and Hybrid scenarios by integrating Azure Stack and other technologies to extend Azure capabilities to on-premises environments and edge devices. Architect and deploy Cloud Native solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, and Azure DevOps. Qualifications You have extensive experience leading the design, development, and deployment of Azure-based solutions – you can see the big picture but maintain credible hands-on skills. You can take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive to conclusion. You have great communication and interpersonal skills and can convey concepts so everyone understands. You’re are able to build relationships with stakeholders at all levels – including upto C-level You are comfortable overseeing and providing technical guidance to large and small teams to design and implement solutions. You are able to work alongside delivery leadership to create and implement work plan for your solutions. About You Characteristics that can spell success for this role Analytical, curious, agile Team player and good communicator Problem-solver, patient, quality-driven Self-motivating Innovative mindset Why Avanade Structured learning and paid certifications with clear pathways to progress into senior engineering and architecture roles. Work on varied client engagements, including regulated environments where quality and security matter. A supportive, collaborative culture with mentoring from experienced practitioners across the global Avanade community. Equal Opportunity Avanade is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

review_candidates.title: Analista de Controladoria em Obras
review_candidates.description: Descrição da Vaga: Analista de Controladoria Descrição O Analista Senior de Controladoria em Obras é responsável por coordenar e executar atividades relacionadas ao controle financeiro e contábil de projetos de construção civil. Este profissional atua de forma estratégica, analisando e interpretando dados para fornecer informações precisas e embasar decisões gerenciais. Além disso, é responsável por garantir o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidas, visando a otimização dos recursos e a maximização dos resultados financeiros da empresa. Atividade Realizar análises financeiras e contábeis de projetos de construção civil, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas Elaborar relatórios gerenciais com informações relevantes para a tomada de decisão da alta direção Participar ativamente no planejamento e controle orçamentário das obras, garantindo a aderência aos custos previstos Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa dos projetos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e redução de custos Realizar o input e a atualização diária de dados operacionais, medições, contratos, aditivos e custos de subempreiteiras no sistema TOTVS. Garantir a consistência e o saneamento da base de dados no TOTVS para geração de relatórios gerenciais e acompanhamento em tempo real. Interagir com outras áreas da empresa, como engenharia e suprimentos, para alinhar informações e garantir a integridade dos dados Analisar indicadores de desempenho e propor ações para otimização dos processos e maximização dos resultados Participar de reuniões estratégicas para apresentar resultados e contribuir com insights para o planejamento futuro Manter-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas de controladoria e aplicar novos conhecimentos no dia a dia do trabalho Zelar pela conformidade das atividades de controladoria com as normas e políticas internas da empresa Acompanhar o fluxo desde a validação do boletim de medição, emissão de nota fiscal, até a liquidação efetiva da receita na conta da empresa. Atuar diretamente para destravar pendências documentais, fiscais ou operacionais que impeçam a liberação de pagamentos por parte dos clientes. Acompanhar a integração e o ramp-up de novas equipes de montagem e subempreiteiras recém-contratadas ("incubadas"). Monitorar os indicadores iniciais de desempenho, curva de aprendizado, aderência aos padrões técnicos da empresa, administrativos e contábeis além do cumprimento dos prazos nos primeiros projetos. Validar as primeiras medições dessas equipes e orientá-las quanto aos processos internos de medição e documentação. Mapear gargalos no fluxo de medição/faturamento e propor otimizações em rotinas Lean e procedimentos operacionais (POPs). Gerenciar o calendário e a consolidação das medições de clientes (receita) e subempreiteiras/fornecedores (custos). Controlar glosas, retenções contratuais e reajustes paramétricos. Monitorar o orçamento Previsto x Realizado (DRE por obra) e sinalizar desvios marginais. Requisitos: Formação em Ensino Superior em Engenharia Civil, Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis. Experiência prévia na área de controladoria. Dominio na ERP TOTVs (lançamentos, medições e contratos). Conhecimento avançado em Excel e sistemas de gestão financeira. Habilidade analítica e capacidade de interpretação de dados. Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

review_candidates.title: ASSISTANT MANAGER, DATA PROTECTION AND IT RISK.
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The IT Risk and Data Protection Assistant Manager will be responsible for overseeing and supporting the bank in identifying, assessing, and mitigating IT and data protection risks while ensuring compliance with data protection laws, internal policies, procedures, and security standards. Key Responsibilities And Accountability Identify, assess, and document IT risks across systems, applications, and infrastructure. Maintain and update the IT risk register and risk treatment plans. Support implementation of risk controls and mitigation measures. Monitor risk indicators and report emerging IT risks. Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and incident management activities. Assist in the definition of the client’s technology risk appetite statements and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against our technology risk appetite. Assist with the Technology Risk reporting operations, including scheduling key monthly meetings, monitoring key milestones, escalation of past-due activities, problem triage and management, and archiving key monthly artifacts for audit purposes. Develop ongoing technology risk reporting, monitoring key trends and defining metrics to regularly measure control effectiveness for own area. Monitor the bank’s adherence to internal policies and procedures, technology control standards, and applicable regulatory guidelines. Adhere to, advise, oversee, monitor, and enforce enterprise frameworks and methodologies that relate to technology controls/information security activities. Inform and advise Equity Bank of its obligations pursuant to the Data Protection Laws. Monitor compliance with the Data Protection Laws and with the policies of the data controller or data processor in relation to the protection of personal data, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of staff involved in personal data processing operations, and the related audits. Provide advice where requested as regards the data protection impact assessment and monitor its performance. Cooperate with the supervisory authority and to act as its contact point on issues relating to the processing of personal data, including prior consultation with the supervisory authority, and to consult, where appropriate, with regard to any other matter. Working with key internal stakeholders in the review of projects to ensure compliance with local data privacy laws, and where necessary, complete and advise on privacy impact assessments. Serving as the primary point of contact for queries in the business regarding data Protection and Privacy. Reviewing Equity vendor contracts and consents needed to implement projects in partnership with the Bank’s Legal and Information Security functions, and ensuring compliance with local regulator requirements. Conduct risk assessments related to data handling and ensure the risk register is in place and is updated. Serve as the point of contact for our Technology Risk Management & Information Security team. Key Critical Competence Behavioural Skills Critical thinking and Problem-solving skills with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolution. Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both orally and in writing. Ethical and moral skills. Have good personal values. Technical skills Knowledge and understanding of modern risk management standards, frameworks, and practices. Knowledge of national and international regulatory environments and key regulatory regimes. Understanding of the national ¬financial industry and business environment. Risk intelligence (critical thinking, creativity, and curiosity, research, surveys, interviews, brainstorming, and scenario planning, analysis of emerging risk, forward-looking). Risk ethics (risk culture, risk appetite, risk governance, and risk accountability Risk communication (communication skills, good listener, team player, positive attitude is a must, report preparation, dashboard, presentation and communication about identified risk and control to be implemented). Risk ethics (risk culture, risk appetite, risk governance, and risk accountability). Knowledge and experience of best-practice Governance, Risk Management and Compliance frameworks and methodologies. Excellent analytical, statistical, and math skills with the ability to interpret vast amounts of performance data and be IT literate. Strong understanding of IT coding, IT information security assessment, and IT risk management. Interpret the Vulnerability assessment report and penetration Testing report Ability to test the incident response plan. Ability to conduct IT risk assessment and provide recommendations on identifi¬ed loopholes. Ability to evaluate the IT environment and assess controls in place and suggest any Improvement. Ability to assess the adequacy of information security tools Qualifications QUALIFICATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE A bachelor’s degree with Second Class Upper, majoring in Computer Engineering, IT, and information security. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in banking, especially in IT risk management. Expert knowledge of IT security and risk disciplines and practices Professional qualification in IT Risk Management and Data Protection risk management is a MUST; one of the following certifications (Certified Information System Auditor (CISA), Certified Data Protection Officer (CDPO), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)). Able to operate in a performance-driven organization and culturally aware, and adapt to working within multicultural settings. Attended Leadership training. Organization Institutional Banking. Requisitos: Principales responsabilidades Gestión de usuarios y grupos: Crear cuentas, configurar perfiles, asignar permisos y administrar grupos de trabajo. Control de licencias: Comprar, asignar, actualizar o retirar las licencias de software para los empleados.
